messages:
jordan_revops: FYI - CloudBridge (reseller) asking for a 15% reseller margin on all Dedicated deals, a 6-month retro credit on signed ARR in H1 they sourced, and co-term billing with net90. They're pushing aggressive margins to lock resell commitment. Need internal approval path.

anya_sales: They're strategic in APAC, helped intro two enterprise logos. +1 to expedite. They said margin is make-or-break.

ciara_partnerships: We have a standard reseller playbook: typical margin 8-12% depending on lead origin and support. 15% is above playbook. Retro credits are possible for referral-to-close but usually capped at 3 months and tied to proof of sourced ARR. Co-terming adds billing complexity.

tom_finance: Key questions: how does 15% impact revenue recognition and gross margin? Also what's the expected uplift in committed ARR vs cost of margin/rebate? Need a modeled P&L for the proposed concession.

kyle_legal: We'll need a reseller addendum, SOWs showing sourced customers, audit rights for credits, and anti-fraud language. Net90 is a bad pattern for cashflow; also need tax/resale certificates depending on region.

billing_bot: Policy note: reseller margin exceptions >12% require CFO sign-off. Retro credits >90 days need VP Sales + Finance approval. See /policies/partners/reseller-discounts.

sophia_cfo: I won't approve 15% blanket margin. Can approve up to 12% for CloudBridge subject to: 1) proof of sourced bookings (signed order forms), 2) retro credit capped at 3 months of recognized revenue and paid as a one-time credit, 3) co-terming only if Finance confirms minimal billing churn, and 4) net60 to start (not net90) with performance milestones. If CloudBridge delivers >$2.5M ARR in 12 months, we can auto-review margin to 14% retroactively.

jordan_revops: Understood. I'll model the P&L and draft the conditional terms for Deal Desk: reseller margin 12% initial, retro credit 3 months (one-time), co-term allowed with a billing churn check, net60 initially, performance trigger for margin bump. Asking @ciara_partnerships to confirm traceability of sourced leads.

ciara_partnerships: I can provide lead attribution reports and signed orders. We'll include audit clause.

tom_finance: Please attach the P&L scenario and expected DSO impact. Finance will tag AR bucket "reseller-exception" and monitor.

kyle_legal: I'll prepare the reseller addendum with clawback language: if customers sourced by CloudBridge churn within 90 days, rebate is clawed back pro rata. Also adding indemnity and IP resale limitations.

billing_bot: Action created: ticket #BILL-2091 (reseller-margin-exception) assigned to jordan_revops. Linked policy doc.

jordan_revops: Thanks. I'll open the Deal Desk request and post the supporting docs here (P&L, lead list, draft addendum). Will ping once submitted. :thumbsup:

sophia_cfo: Provisional approval granted per my conditions above. Finance and Legal to finalize language prior to execution. We'll reassess after first 90 days.

anya_sales: On it. Closing loop with CloudBridge and will push for signatures this week.

jordan_revops: (added) Deal Desk request submitted, docs uploaded to ticket #BILL-2091. Next step: Legal review and Finance sign-off to finalize billing setup.
